approvedEdits.old: Gallery examples are created for this site as inspiration. They are not copied from competitors, user comments, or third-party art packs.

approvedEdits.label: Rights section / first paragraph

paragraphs: About the project

My Square Face Icon is a free browser tool site for people who want a cute square profile icon without signing up, installing software, or opening a full design app. The project centers on a square face generator experience and supports it with practical guides, examples, and privacy-aware community features.

A good profile picture should be quick to make and easy to recognize at small sizes. Many users only need a playful avatar for Discord, TikTok, YouTube, forums, game profiles, classroom projects, or small communities. My Square Face Icon keeps that workflow simple: open the generator, create a face, and save or share the result when the tool supports it.
This page also explains what visitors should know about My Square Face Icon before using the generator, gallery, guides, or community features.

The site is designed as a focused tool first, not a large social network. Pages are added only when they support the generator, answer a real search intent, or help visitors make better avatar choices.
The main page keeps the avatar tool visible in the first viewport so visitors can start creating without hunting through a landing page.
Support pages explain icon readability, cute avatar style, platform crops, and practical profile image workflows.

The homepage shows site-curated icon examples. The gallery includes simple style examples and approved community submissions when available. Selection or moderation does not establish authorship or grant image-use permissions.

Square and Oval run third-party Flash (SWF) files through Ruffle. We have not verified the original source, rights holder, or permissions for the exact files used here, including hosting, public use, redistribution, and use of generated images. The site's availability and examples do not establish authorization or grant third-party rights.
If the product expands into more avatar makers, each new URL should contain a real usable tool or a clearly useful guide. We avoid publishing thin pages that exist only to target a keyword.

The generator experience runs in the browser. Public comments are moderated before publishing, and email addresses submitted with comments are not displayed publicly. Optional image uploads are intended for sharing avatar creations, not for collecting personal documents or sensitive information.
You can read the full details in the Privacy Policy and Terms of Service. Content standards, AI assistance, and page quality rules are documented in the Editorial Policy.
